messages:
Maya: Heads up — hitting a reproducible divergence in streamed outputs right after ~8k tokens on magnet13b-int4. KV cache logs show a 'flush' event mid-generation.
Sahil: hmm, can you paste the log and repro command? :eyes:
Maya: repro command:
```
python reproduce.py --model magnet13b-int4 --seq 12000 --stream --seed 42
```
and relevant log snippet:
```
[2026-03-21T10:12:34Z] KV: flush_evicted window=8192 seq=8193 reason=memory_pressure shard=2
[2026-03-21T10:12:34Z] KV: prefill_resume from=0 to=8193
[2026-03-21T10:12:34Z] Runtime: resumed_streaming, token=8194, kv_base=0
[2026-03-21T10:12:34Z] Warning: kv-index-mismatch expected=8193 actual=0
```
Maya: model is quant4 -> actually int4 artifact, but we tested with int8 and still see something
Linh: sounds like a flush race with streaming prefill resumption. Could be RoPE wrap around when base shifts. Try setting ROPE_CHECK=1 and re-running.
Devon: also try --no-prefill-cache and --prefill-shift=0 to rule out partial-prefill resume bug.
Oliver: which commit/branch? any recent changes to tiling or shard-join? That kv-index-mismatch looks bad.
Maya: bisected to commit 1a2b3c (tiling-v2) — reverting that makes the problem go away in local check.
Sahil: tiling-v2 added compact-evict that uses flush at window boundary. Maybe off-by-one when window==shard*chunk.
qa-bot: nightly-fuzz reported 7 regressions similar to this in last 24h: https://ci/internal/fuzz/9843
Linh: quick patch idea: ensure prefill resume sets kv_base = prev_base when flush happens mid-stream; add assert in runtime.
Devon: can you run a tiny canary with that assert? I'll schedule a canary on dedicated with 12k seq.
Maya: running now on canary branch kv-fix/longflush — will post results.
[~10m later]
Maya: canary run 5/5 passes, no kv-index-mismatch. Outputs match baseline :tada:
Oliver: nice. open PR, link to bisect + logs, add a regression test with stream at 12k.
Sahil: also add a quantized variant to the regression (int4).
Maya: will do. PR up in a bit. Thanks all. :pray:
